simple.summary: עֲנָת (ʻĂnâth) means Anath , an Israelite First listed occurrence: Judg 3 31.

definitions.full: H6067. Anath עֲנָת proper name, masculine father of Shamgar Judg 3:31 ; 5:6 , Αναθ ( Δειναχ , Κεναθ ); — see also ׳ב עֲנָת עֲנוֺת, בֵּית (compare Tel Amarna proper name Anati , Wkl 125, 43 ; Assyrian proper name, of deities Anatu (Jastr Rel. Babylonian 153; hence) in Syria and Phoenician — also Egypt — ענת (Muss-Arn JBL xi (1892), 80 Pietschm Phön. 149 f. Hal JAssyrian 7, x (1877), 374 ; xiii (1879), 208)).
